overview.text: The Chihuahuan (Texas) Night Snake is a small, night-active snake with a very mild venom, harmless to people.

identification.text: Light grey or tan with dark blotches down the back, a plain belly, smooth scales and vertical pupils.

size.label: Adults
size.text: About 10 to 16 in (25 to 40 cm); the record is 20 in.

distribution.label: Native
distribution.text: From southern Kansas and Colorado through New Mexico and western Texas to central Mexico.

diet.text: Mainly lizards, also small snakes and soft insects.

reproduction.text: Breeds in the spring rainy season and lays 4 to 6 eggs, which hatch after about 8 weeks.

recognise.text: Small, pale and blotched, with vertical pupils.
